subject: 南京灵谷寺无梁殿单体正面
author: ScareCriterion12

sources.author: ScareCriterion12
sources.note: 完整正面，树木局部遮挡；与近景共同核定三个圆拱与两重檐。

sources.author: 西安兵马俑
sources.note: 正面局部实拍补充门洞轮廓，未单独用来推断完整殿体。

source_note: 两张实景共同核对；保持三圆拱门洞、低平重檐、三塔形脊饰，删除树木、铭文和人物；官方明确明代，1381以寺院迁建纪年作约略排序。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT: Wuliang Dian (Beamless Hall), Linggu Temple, Nanjing, a very broad low Ming brick-vaulted hall, not a timber-framed temple. Match the full front of this actual hall from photo 2; photo 3 is a closer detail reference for the central facade. Preserve TWO widely separated shallow eave levels, the long high ridge, THREE small stupa-shaped ornaments evenly across that ridge (the central is tallest), the massive plain brick wall planes, and exactly THREE round-headed arch doorways, central slightly larger, with flanking smaller rectangular windows near the outer sides. The front elevation has five main structural sections: three arches plus two flanking plain bays/windows, not five arches. Remove trees to reveal the existing complete symmetrical outline, do not invent additional wings or columns. Roof is double-eaved hip-and-gable, compact and shallow in frontal view. Keep the actual exceptional long low proportions, about 3.5:1 wide:high overall. No repetitive roof-tile lines or brick lattice; just roof ridges, eaves, openings and a few carefully selected structural edges. Every arch interior, plaque and window remains WHITE and empty; no lettering. Do not draw the memorial plaques text, barriers, plants, people or foreground paving. Thin linework only, at least 120 pixels of pure white space around the left/right outer eave tips, whole hall centered and uncropped. Sparse refinement like master.
caption: 灵谷寺无梁殿 · 砖券大殿正面
明代遗构 · 重檐九脊与三塔脊饰

historical_sources.title: 钟山风景名胜区：无梁殿
historical_sources.supports: 明代遗构，砖石拱券，面宽50米进深34米；重檐九脊、三座喇嘛塔脊饰。

historical_sources.title: 钟山风景名胜区：灵谷景区
historical_sources.supports: 灵谷寺于明洪武十四年1381迁建此地；该年仅用于明初建筑阶段的近似排序。

site_recommendation.name: 灵谷寺无梁殿
site_recommendation.year_note: 1381是寺院迁建此地的已知年份，作为现存明初殿宇的约略排序点，不据此声称本殿某月某日竣工。
site_recommendation.place: 江苏 · 南京 · 钟山
site_recommendation.coordinate_note: 采用正面实拍公开相机坐标作殿前近似定位。
site_recommendation.lede: 灵谷寺无梁殿用厚重砖墙和连续拱券承托屋面，正面三座拱门穿过宽阔墙身。两层浅檐上方的三枚塔形脊饰，标出了这座明代砖殿的轮廓。
facts: 现存无梁殿为明代建筑，灵谷寺于洪武十四年（1381）迁建此处。
殿体不用木梁，砖石砌筑的拱券承担结构；“无量殿”与“无梁殿”两名并存。
据景区资料，殿宽约50米、深约34米，重檐九脊屋面上立三座塔形脊饰。
